correctness.rationale: The finite graph is on all 161280 fully labelled order-five Latin squares; 1344 squares with first row fixed times 5! gives all vertices exactly once. For two rows or columns, a relative derangement is either a five-cycle or disjoint (2,3) cycles, and one legal switch exchanges exactly a single minimal cycle. A distinct independent exhaustive C++ reconstruction enumerated 1344 normalized squares, expanded all 161280, counted 288000/576000/1036800 unique undirected edges at lengths 2/3/5, and computed DSU components (17280 singles plus eight of 18000 for 2; 17280 singles plus two of 72000 for 2,3; six of 2880 plus two of 72000 for 2,3,5); all 17280 cyclic-class squares have zero intercalates and the other 144000 have four. This is exhaustive over a finite, fixed domain, not an extrapolation to higher orders. Independently checked the complete source RESULT.md, both supplied verifier implementations, and actual frozen Git tree/blobs.
